Pankaj Mahato @ Pankaj Kumar Mahato vs The State Of Bihar
on 3 October, 2024

Author: Anjani Kumar Sharan
Bench: Anjani Kumar Sharan
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Patna
 Criminal Miscellaneous No.65817 of 2024
 Arising Out of Ps. Case No.-658 Year-2023 Thana- Siwan Complaint Case 
 Siwan
 ======================================================
 Pankaj Mahato @ Pankaj Kumar Mahato Son of Krishna Mahato Resident of
 Village- Mathurapur, Police Station- Barhariya, District- Siwan.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Versus
 1. The State of Bihar Bihar
 2. Puja Kumari Wife of Pankaj Mahto, Daughter of Tarkeshwar Mahato
 Resident of village- Harpur, P.S.- Goreyakothi, District- Siwan.

... ... Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Ajay Kumar Tiwary  For the State : Mrs. Gulnar Begum  For the O.P. No.2 : Mr. Rakesh Kumar Shrivastava  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ANJANI KUMAR SHARAN  ORAL ORDER 2 03-10-2024 Heard learned counsels for the parties.
2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code.
3. Petitioner, who is husband of informant/complainant, is said to have ousted her from the matrimonial home in association of his family members over the dowry demand.
4. It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is an innocent person and has committed no offence.
Petitioner has neither made any dowry demand nor drove her out of her matrimonial home nor tormented her over the demand of dowry.

The petitioner has relied upon the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.65817 of 2024(2) dt.03-10-2024 judgment of this Court in the case of Md. Naimul Haque Ansari @ Naimul Haque Ansari & Ors. Vs. The State of Bihar, reported in 2006 (3) PLJR 182.

sentences.text:
In that view of the matter, let the above named petitioner, be released on bail, in the event of his arrest or surrender before the learned Court below within a period of six weeks from today, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Court below where the case is pending/successor Court in connection with Complaint Case No.658 of 2023, subject to the condition as laid down under Section 438 (2) of the Cr.P.C.,
6.
Petitioner is ready to pay Rs.4000.00 (Rupees Four Thousand) per month to the informant/complainant in the second week of every month.

If the petitioner fails to pay the aforesaid amount on two consecutive months, informant/complainant shall be at liberty to move before the learned Court below for cancelling the bail bond of the petitioner.
7. It goes without saying that the aforesaid payment shall be subject to any order being passed in matrimonial maintenance case or any other collateral proceedings.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.65817 of 2024(2) dt.03-10-2024 8.
Learned counsel for the informant/complainant is directed to furnish the bank account details of informant/complainant in the learned Court below.

If she fails to furnish the same, the aforesaid amount will be deposited in the learned Court below which will be released in favour of the informant/complainant after she furnishes her bank account details.

9. If so advised, either of the parties will be at liberty to make an application before the learned Court below for referring the matter to the District Mediation Center for the purpose of reconciliation or one time settlement.
10. With the aforesaid observation and direction, this application stands disposed of.

(Anjani Kumar Sharan, J) shikha/-
